rows.why: ATTRIBUTION: scale path: the scale multiply reads row 0's scale for both rows; survives with the value check off, so its kill above is the value check
ATTRIBUTION: codebook index: row 1 decodes row 0's nibble; survives with the value check off, so its kill above is the value check
ATTRIBUTION: out_shift: the coarse shift drops one byte step; survives with the value check off, so its kill above is the value check
ATTRIBUTION: dropped valid: a row-tile result is never pushed when the last block also starts the row-tile; still killed with the value check off (the result count)
rows.new: e1_v <= c_v and c_l and not c_f;
